name: Gang Member
description:
You're an initiated member of one of the gangs of Nïrwe, and they've taught you how to get what you want.

Whenever you roll Awe to intimidate one or more creatures, the roll is favored.

Once per Quest or Intermezzo, you may gain 1 Shadow to acquire an equipment item without paying its Treasure cost. When you do, if you are in the Quest phase, move the Quest one notch toward Bane; If you are in the Intermezzo phase, your next Quest begins one notch toward Bane.

At the end of each Quest, you must pay 10% of the treasure you acquired during the Quest - rounded up - to your gang.

Describe the gang and how you joined it.
